source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: A Healthier You: Based on the Dietary Guidelines for Americans, US Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Disease Prevention and Health Promotion

ingredients.name: tart apples, cored, peeled and chopped

steps.instruction: Lightly oil a 13 by 9 by 2 inch pan.
Mix 5 cups of apples, 1 cup of sugar, 1 cup of raisins and 1/2 cup of pecans.
steps.spoken: In a large mixing bowl, combine the apples with the sugar, raisins and pecans. Mix well.

steps.instruction: Let the apple mixture stand for 30 minutes.
Stir in 1/4 cup of oil, 2 teaspoons of vanilla and the beaten egg.
Sift together 2 1/2 cups flour, 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.
Stir the flour mixture into the apple mixture, about 1/3 at a time.
steps.spoken: Stir the flour mixture into the apple mixture about 1/3 at a time, just enough to moisten the dry ingredients.

steps.instruction: Turn the batter into the pan.
Cool the cake slightly before serving.
steps.spoken: Cool the cake slightly before serving. This makes 20 servings.
